flow_ref: User story (not in flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui route/route.ts and components/Notification.ts, ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsRefundNotice (refund record without bank data). No bank account, unique URL or bank letter/reminder code in ocmseserviceapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi
note: Status in stories.json: No requirement (URA's requirement text is not given). The story asks that an offender who got a URA letter/reminder opens a unique URL, fills in bank account details, and that the data reaches URA for the refund. No code exists for this in the six repos: grep for bank / account number / payee / GIRO / unique URL / refund link across all repos (excluding the stale cronservice copy) finds no field, endpoint, route or template about bank accounts. The only 'bank' hit is a warning text in Notification.ts:29 (URA never asks for a transfer or bank details). What exists is the staff-side refund record (OcmsRefundNotice, no bank/URL/token column) and refund reports in the cron; the eservice routes are only payment and furnish-particulars. The URA letter/reminder and the hand-over to URA: cannot verify from repo, they may be built outside the six repos. No maintenance ticket touches bank account capture (the refund tickets found, e.g. OCMS-SR-2026-112, only concern refund ID and Exception report).
recommendation: Do not claim. No code exists for bank account capture via a unique URL. Ask URA/the team whether it is built outside the six repos, or mark as gap

steps.step: The offender receives a URA letter/reminder containing a unique URL for bank account details
steps.detail: Refund record (OcmsRefundNotice.java:27-58) only has refund_notice_id, receipt_no, notice_no, amount and reason; no URL, token or bank-reminder status column. No unique URL generator or bank letter/reminder type exists in any repo. A letter issued by URA itself: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The offender opens the unique URL and the bank account form page appears
steps.detail: The eservice route list only has payment, payment/processing, payment/success, payment/failure and furnish-particulars (route.ts:15-41). No bank account / refund route or page, and no URL token validation.

steps.step: The offender fills in the bank account details on the form
steps.detail: No bank field (bank name, account number, account holder) in the eservice UI. The only occurrence of 'bank' is the warning text Notification.ts:29 stating URA never asks for bank details.

steps.step: The submitted bank account details are stored by the system
steps.detail: No entity, repository or endpoint in ocmseserviceapi/ocmsadminapi stores a bank account. OcmsRefundNotice.java:27-58 has no bank column.

steps.step: URA receives the bank account details to proceed with the refund
steps.detail: No interface or job passes a bank account to URA; grep for bank/account/payee in thirdpartyapi and ocmsadminprivateapi/src finds nothing. The cron only has refund reports (DailyPaidReportJob.java:33, :131), not a bank hand-over. URA's side: cannot verify from repo.
